note: Hand-written weekly recaps, keyed league -> week number. Written every Tuesday from data/2026/week-NN.json; every number in a paragraph must trace to that file. Voice: Hall of Fame & Shame roast level -- punch at the decision, not the person. Real names in two_mitchs (config.json maps them), Sleeper handles everywhere else.

shape.headline: one line, the week in a sentence
shape.facts: optional array of 3-5 {k, v}; leave it out and the page builds the strip from the data
shape.paragraphs: array of strings, 2-3 paragraphs / ~200 words. **bold** and *italic* allowed, nothing else.
